content: Isha Agarwal calls Ravi Menon to confirm that auto-pay has been successfully set up for her policy, with the first premium deduction scheduled for the 15th. She also inquires about the costs of optional coverages (personal-property add-on at $75/year, flood at $120/year, and earthquake at $95/year), how to add earthquake coverage via email link without filling out extra forms, and re-confirms the $500 per claim deductible and $300,000 dwelling coverage limit.

action_items: Optionally click the link sent in email to add earthquake coverage
